If ‘P’ stands for ‘×’, ‘Q’ stands for ‘÷’, ‘R’ stands for ‘−’ and ‘S’ stands for ‘+’, then what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

(63 P 2) R (24 P 3) S (98 Q 2) R (48 Q 3) R 3 = ?

Given equation: (63 P 2) R (24 P 3) S (98 Q 2) R (48 Q 3) R 3 = ? 

Now, if sign are interchanged, then:

**(63 x 2) - (24 x 3) + (98 ÷ 2) - (48 ÷ 3) - 3 = ? **

⇒ (126) - (72) + (49) - (16) - 3 = **84**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question: B starts from Point A and drives 16 km towards the south. He then takes a right turn and drives 12 km, then turns right and drives 19 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 21 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and in which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
questions.solution:
Given: 

B starts from Point A and drives 16 km towards the south.

He then takes a right turn and drives 12 km, then turns right and drives 19 km. 

He then takes a right turn and drives 21 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5674fe00daf9a2fb72cde61d84fe5a63a1d8c8c2234c0ced4beaa79a365ef3d4.png] 

Current Position (P): 9 km East of A and 0 km North/South of A.

Shortest Distance: The distance between (9, 0) and (0, 0) is 9 - 0 = 9 km.

Direction: To move from P (9, 0) to A (0, 0), B must move 9 km in the negative X direction, which is West.

So, B must drive 9 km to the West to reach Point A.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Total Students = 49

Amir's Rank from Right = 22nd

Amir's Rank from Left = 28th

So, Tarun's position from the left end of the line

Total Students = 49

 Amir's Rank from Right = 22nd

Amir's Rank from Left = 28th

Tarun is to the Left by 23 positions

Tarun's Final Rank from Left = 28 - 23 = **5th**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All sharks are salmons.

Some salmons are tunas.

Conclusions:

I. Some sharks are tunas.

II. No tunas are sharks.
questions.solution:
Statements:

All sharks are salmons.

Some salmons are tunas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/737f62b6a1ef807e91a2e70e55d867017271211c69b296bcf7a32b88f5942ede.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some sharks are tunas. - **False**(because there is no direct relation is given between shark and tuna, so it can be possible only).

II. No tunas are sharks. - **False(**because there is no direct relation is given between shark and tuna, so it can be possible only)

So, the conclusion is Either conclusion (I) or (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**

**Note: **

Complementary pair

1) When both the elements of conclusions are the same.

2) When both the conclusions are false individually.

There are only two different types of complementary pairs, which satisfy the condition of either or.

​1) All - Some not

2) No - Some

Here, some + no forms a complementary pair.

questions.question:

Select the number-pair in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following pairs. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding to/subtracting from/multiplying with 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

9, 108

16, 192
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number × 12) = 2nd number.

9, 108

⇒ (9 × 12) = 108

16, 192

⇒ (16 × 12) = 192​

Now, checking the options:

Option 1) 14, 154

⇒ (14 × 12) ≠ 154

Option 2) 6, 66

⇒ (6 × 12) ≠ 66

Option 3) 12, 162

⇒ (12 × 12) ≠ 162

**Option 4) 11, 132**

**⇒ (11 × 12) = 132**

Hence, the correct option is "Option 4"
